Choco Pudding
By: Mateja ^_^
Published: Sunday, January 2, 2011 - 12:52pm

Ingredients




Ingredients:
4 oz. semi-sweet chocolate
1 tablespoon unsalted butter
4 cups milk
2 tablespoons sugar
8 tablespoons corn starch

Preparation

1 Directions: 2 First, melt the chocolate with the butter over a double broiler. Set aside. 3 Into a big enough pot, put 3 ½ cups of milk and sugar. Bring to a gentle boil over medium heat. Turn the heat down to low and add the melted chocolate, stir to combine. 4 In a small bowl, mix corn starch with ½ cup of milk. Stir to combine and add the corn starch slurry into the boiling milk. Stir constantly to prevent clumping. Hand whisk comes very handy! 5 When the pudding thickens and it starts to bubble, pour it into 4 serving glass bowls. 6 Chill, garnish, serve, and enjoy!

About


My daughter was in charge of dessert the other day and she decided to make us chocolate pudding. It turned out very delicious!
